name: Can I remove mold from my bathroom myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I remove mold from my bathroom myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can typically remove small patches of surface mold in your bathroom yourself if it covers an area less than 10 square feet and is on non-porous surfaces like tile or fiberglass. Use appropriate safety gear, such as gloves and a mask, and a scrubbing brush with a mold-killing solution. However, if the mold covers a larger area, if you suspect it's hidden, or if you or family members have respiratory issues, it's safer and more effective to call a professional. DIY methods might not address the root cause or prevent future growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can remove small, surface mold patches yourself with precautions. For larger areas, hidden mold, or health concerns, professional help is recommended.
